summary: PangkasKAKA backend + frontend tested. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases passed (100%) covering auth (4 roles), shops (Haversine sort), slots (greedy generator), bookings (create+pay+cancel+409 race), owner (dashboard/orders/CRUD/karyawan evaluate=88→active barber auto-created), admin (dashboard/pending/verify/users), karyawan apply, hairstyles (12 seeded), AI face-scan (endpoint reachable & JSON schema validated), notifications. MongoDB _id and password never leaked. Frontend: login screen renders with 4 demo buttons; customer login → home shows 4 approved shops sorted by distance (800m→3.2km) with correct Bayesian ratings; shop detail loads services & barbers; AI Scan screen loads with KAMERA/GALERI options; owner dashboard shows 'Kupang Cuts Barber APPROVED' with stats; admin dashboard shows 5 toko / 1 pending / 4 pelanggan / Rp 60.000 revenue; karyawan portal shows Marchel Tuka with 'ACTIVE Skor 88/120' + 4 shops to apply. Login submit uses testID 'login-submit-button' (not 'login-button' as initially guessed).

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the tab-label text 'Verifikasi' did not navigate to the verification screen (URL stayed at /dashboard). Tabs likely need dedicated testIDs on the Pressable/Tab.Button, not just on the label Text. Verify Expo Router Tabs configuration in /app/frontend/app/(admin)/_layout.tsx.

action_items: Add testID to bottom Tab buttons in (admin)/_layout.tsx, (owner)/_layout.tsx, (customer)/_layout.tsx so E2E tests can navigate between tabs reliably (e.g. testID='tab-verifikasi', 'tab-orders').

Consider adding aliased testIDs 'email-input', 'password-input', 'login-button' on login screen to match common conventions (currently 'login-email', 'login-password', 'login-submit-button'). Optional.

Full end-to-end booking flow (service→barber→slot→confirm→QRIS pay simulation→appears in Pesanan) was validated via backend API but not clicked through the UI due to token limits; main agent may self-test this UI flow.

AI face-scan UI screen loads (KAMERA/GALERI buttons visible); actual Gemini roundtrip was tested via backend and accepts calls. Recommend manual smoke test with a real face photo via the GALERI picker.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 271 contains a dead-code branch (`if False`) with a confusing DAY_NAMES calculation; the correct value is set on line 275. Recommend removing dead code.

In compute_available_slots, past-time check uses '<= now' which excludes the current-minute slot; acceptable but note off-by-one boundary. WITA (UTC+8) is assumed regardless of user's timezone — OK per spec (Kupang).
server.py is ~1195 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers/ (auth.py, shops.py, bookings.py, owner.py, admin.py, ai.py, seed.py).
expire_stale_bookings runs on every /shops, /slots, /bookings, /bookings/{id} GET — could be optimized with a periodic background task, but not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all role dashboards & key screens verified; deep booking UI walkthrough not clicked)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Backend auto-seed created 12 hairstyles, 4 approved shops, 1 pending shop, and 4 role test users, plus auto-added karyawan→barber (Marchel Tuka, skill=Standar) from the evaluate test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. To test deeper UI: use testIDs 'demo-{role}' + 'login-submit-button' for login. Tab bar tabs currently lack testIDs — click by role/text may not work reliably; recommend adding testID before next UI iteration. Booking flow start point is shop card `data-testid=shop-card-<uuid>` on /home. AI face-scan requires a real face image (see /app/image_testing.md). Backend endpoint /api/ai/face-scan does not accept blank/synthetic images — will return 502 from Gemini for garbage input.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in backend. Minor UI observation: tab navigation testIDs missing.
